description: WHAT: Search maps llms-keywords.txt (keyword → maps URL). q required. RETURNS matching keyword/url rows (clamped limit). USE for SEO/keyword → Gebiet page. DOES NOT search www keywords. NEXT: get_service_area / get_embed_map with the slug from the URL.

limit.description: Maximum items or lines to return after offset. Omit = all remaining in the window (subject to tool-specific clamps). For geo near-search default is often 5 without radius_km, up to 52 with radius.

locale.description: maps is German-only (de). Omit or pass de. Other values are ignored; URLs stay https://maps.ikeytz.com/… with no locale prefix. Not a www multi-locale switch — use @ikeytz/mcp list_locales on www for en|fr|ru|fa|ar|tr.

q.description: Required search string matched against keyword and URL (substring, case-insensitive).

name: find_by_keyword
title: Find By Keyword
